the suffix makes the match impossible, which is what forces the engine to

MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED (04-08-2026, H1926). The textbook ReDoS shapes —
optimizer and complete in under 4 ms at repeat=40, so freezing them here
would have produced a fixture that proves nothing while looking rigorous.
Every case below was measured to hit the 50 ms per-match timeout at
repeat=30 on that engine. Under stdlib `re` the same cases do not finish
in 120 s at repeat=24 — that gap IS the mitigation, which is why the
engine choice is part of the contract and not an implementation detail.
The frozen expectation is TERMINATION (a counted timeout), never a match
verdict. A case that starts completing honestly has stopped being
adversarial and belongs in regex_compat_scholarly.json instead.
